import unittest
from cache_store import LRUCache


class LRUCacheTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_get_returns_none_for_a_missing_key(self):
        cache = LRUCache(2)
        self.assertIsNone(cache.get('missing'))

    def test_get_updates_recency_before_eviction(self):
        cache = LRUCache(2)
        cache.put('alpha', 10)
        cache.put('beta', 20)
        self.assertEqual(cache.get('alpha'), 10)
        cache.put('gamma', 30)
        self.assertIsNone(cache.get('beta'))
        self.assertEqual(cache.get('alpha'), 10)
        self.assertEqual(cache.get('gamma'), 30)

    def test_updating_a_key_replaces_its_value_and_refreshes_recency(self):
        cache = LRUCache(2)
        cache.put('alpha', 10)
        cache.put('beta', 20)
        cache.put('alpha', 11)
        cache.put('gamma', 30)
        self.assertEqual(cache.get('alpha'), 11)
        self.assertIsNone(cache.get('beta'))

    def test_validates_capacity(self):
        for capacity in (0, -1):
            with self.subTest(capacity=capacity):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    LRUCache(capacity)
        for capacity in (True, 2.5):
            with self.subTest(capacity=capacity):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    LRUCache(capacity)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
